correctness.rationale: The complete 21-arc subset model has 2,927 faces including the empty face. A complete verified acyclic discrete-Morse pairing leaves one 0-cell and (24,54,17) critical cells in degrees (3,4,5). Signed integral Morse boundaries have d5=0 and d4 rational rank 11 with an explicit full-rank minor of determinant -1; hence all nonzero Smith factors are 1, yielding Z^13, Z^43, Z^17 and no other reduced homology. Independent enumeration and direct finite-field boundaries reproduce all ranks. Signed C7 orbit complex has exact rational boundary ranks (2,22,68,90,20); its invariant Betti numbers (1,7,5), combined with the total Betti dimensions, prove the asserted Q[C7] decompositions. All necessary programs and data are embedded.

value.rationale: The regular seven-vertex cyclic tournament is a canonical minimal-scale nontransitive setting beyond studied transitive families. A complete integral calculation with three separate nonzero homology degrees and the full rational cyclic-character multiplicities is a structural invariant: the six-dimensional nontrivial isotypic multiplicities are not supplied by ordinary Betti numbers or the known transitive theorem. The exact natural example is mathematically motivated even without an all-order classification.
